title: 第48章 满场站着的，唯唐逸一人！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 天香楼的对面，就是正在装修的迎客楼。唐逸没有进自己的迎客楼，也没有进天香楼，只是淡淡看了一眼站在大门前迎客的唐家父子三人，便转身向不远处的角落走去。在天香楼左侧偏僻的屋檐下，一个发须洁白的老人，正安静地靠在躺椅上，一边喝酒一边晒太阳。此时，太阳已经西下，夕阳打在老人的身上，让他多了几分的慈祥和温和。但唐逸知道，这位老人曾经肯定是凶名赫赫的人物。因为他半敞的胸上，全是纵横交错的刀疤。唐逸将一壶酒放在老人的面前，打开瓶盖，然后平静地坐在老人的身侧，没有说话。许久，老人实在抗拒不住酒香的诱惑，而且这酒见空气时间久了，味就没了。“小子，有事求咱家就说，没必要糟蹋酒，美酒无罪。”老太监捡起地上的酒壶，盖上盖子。“的确有事，想借您的地方，办一点私事。”唐逸点头。“会出人命？”老太监问了一句。唐逸摇头，道：“不会，但可能会发生一点动乱……”老太监想了想，道：“那一壶酒不够，天香楼要是出了动乱，砸的是天香楼的招牌，你小子凭一壶酒，就想砸咱家的招牌？不能够。”“当然，除非你办的私事，能有个说服咱家的理由。”唐逸眼底闪过一丝冷意，道：“我妹妹受伤了，遍体鳞伤，而凶手，现在正在里面春风得意。”老人微闭的老眼陡然睁开，看向唐逸：“是昨日那小娃娃？”唐逸点头。老者微微颔首，随即靠在躺椅上，声音平静而冷漠：“嗯，去吧，打狠一点。”唐逸站起身，恭敬冲着老者躬身行礼。重新回到天香楼前，看着络绎不绝的宾客，唐逸脸上不由有些讥讽。唐家的大概情况，他是知道的，唐浩母子俩已经将唐家生意搞得亏成渣，府里连几百两都拿不出来了。而天香楼宴客，打底万两起。他还真搞不清，唐家现在哪里还有银子来大宴宾客。当然，这和他没关系。“四弟，你总算来了。”还没走到大门，唐画已经笑着迎了上来。“今日是咱们唐家的大喜之日，你要是不来，我和唐浩都准备回去扛着你过来了。”唐画揽着唐逸的肩膀，笑着冲唐敬道：“爹，看吧，我就说小逸在大是大非面前，还是分得很清楚的。”唐逸淡淡扫了唐画一眼。这是拿话点他呢！我是拿了你的诗夺的状元位，但你要有大局观，为了唐家，你就得忍气吞声。呵……想得美！“怎么？来了也没话对你哥说吗？”唐敬看到唐逸来，心里是有一点点欣慰的。毕竟今日是唐家宴会，唐家嫡子却不到算怎么回事？只是看到唐逸脸色淡漠，他顿时不满了：“你哥哥刚刚中状元，连几句祝福的话，你都不知道说吗？”唐逸淡淡一笑，道：“我说恭喜，他可能会掉脑袋，你确定？”殿试盗诗，那可是欺君之罪。搁在这个时代，不仅唐画要掉脑袋，难说还会连累全家。“放肆！”唐敬脸色骤沉，险些忍不住一巴掌甩在唐逸脸上。你哥刚中状元，前途无可限量，你敢诅咒他？“唐逸，你别不识好歹，在你面前的是新科状元，也是翰林院修撰，还敢狂妄？”唐浩冷哼一声，满脸得意道：“信不信我哥现在一句话，整死你就跟整死一只蚂蚁一样？”唐画瞪了唐浩一眼，道：“自家兄弟，说那些死不死的干嘛？”话落，唐画揽着唐逸的肩膀，附身在他耳侧。在外人看来，两人是在讲悄悄话，因为唐画的嘴角，笑容儒雅迷人。然而。他的话却极为冰冷，充满挑衅。“我的好弟弟，真是谢谢你了。”“要不是你那一首诗，恐怕状元还真和我没缘。”“我知道你不甘，但不甘你又能如何呢？”“你现在只能忍着，想反抗……呵呵，你觉得你这废物的话？谁相信你！”说到这里，唐画笑意更浓了，道：“帮你写那首诗的，应该就是那所谓的小诗仙吧？这样吧，你告诉我小诗仙是谁？我保证让你和唐音，安稳过完余生如何？”小诗仙是不能活的！只有找到他，让他彻底地闭嘴，他盗窃诗获得状元的事，才会永远隐藏下去。唐逸闻言也是笑了起来，道：“唐画，好好跳吧，你也就能跳这几天了。”“等收拾你的人回到京都，你会知道什么叫身败名裂。”“至于小诗仙……”唐逸抬手指了指自己，道：“不好意思，外面盛传的小诗仙，就是我。”唐画说的话是压低声音说的，没有人听到。但唐逸却没有压低声音，他的话唐敬和唐浩也都听到了。唐画和唐浩忍不住差点仰天大笑，你是诗仙？哈哈哈……你是诗仙？你要是诗仙？那秦淮河上能将整个京都文人的尸体填满了。唐敬也是脸色铁青，下意识想要捂住唐逸的嘴，好在这时候该来的宾客已经来了，门前只有他们父子几人。不然让人听到唐逸的话，还不知道得闹出多大的笑话呢！“混账东西，想要荣耀，那就和你哥一样用本事去挣，吹牛算什么本事。”唐敬走上前，怒斥道：“我知道你羡慕你哥，他中了状元你心理不平衡，但你今天给我老实点，敢丢人，我饶不了你！”唐逸睨了一眼唐敬，呵，又自己加戏。你哪只眼睛看到我心理不平衡了？他正想说话，这时，街外传来一道尖锐的声音。“太子驾到！”听到这话，原本喧嚣的酒楼瞬间安静下来。唐逸循声望去，果然看到一辆豪华的马车，在上百兵马的保护下，渐渐往酒楼这边驶来。很快，马车便停在了天香楼外。一个年轻太监掀开车帘，搀扶着一个青年从车上下来。青年身材颀长，穿着一身锦衣，一头长发被金冠束缚，整个人浑身上下都透着一股儒雅的书生气。唐逸上下打量了太子，总觉得这家伙的面相和萧策有几分相像啊！也对，他怀疑萧策是某位王爷，那就是皇帝的兄弟，那个太子有几分相像也说得过去。只是他没想到的是，唐家的庆功宴，竟然连太子都惊动了。在他身侧，唐敬，唐画，唐浩的呼吸都急促了起来。太子亲临，那是给他唐家天大的面子了！“参见太子殿下！”“参见太子殿下！”唐敬，唐画，以及酒楼中的所有人，都齐齐跪下行礼。唯独唐逸，只是弯腰做了一个拱手礼。满场，站着的就只有他一个人。
content_en: Opposite Tianxiang Building is the Yingke Building which is being renovated.Tang Yi did not enter his own guest building, nor did he enter the Tianxiang Building. He just glanced at the Tang family's father and son who were standing in front of the gate to welcome guests, then turned and walked to a corner not far away.Under the remote eaves on the left side of Tianxiang Tower, an old man with white hair and beard was quietly leaning on a lounge chair, drinking and basking in the sun.At this time, the sun had already set in the west, and the setting sun hit the old man's body, making him a little more kind and gentle.But Tang Yi knew that this old man must have been a notorious figure.Because his half-open chest was covered with crisscross scars.Tang Yi placed a bottle of wine in front of the old man, opened the bottle cap, and then sat calmly beside the old man without speaking.For a long time, the old man couldn't resist the temptation of the aroma of wine, and the wine lost its flavor after being exposed to the air for a long time."Boy, if you ask me anything, just tell me. There is no need to waste wine. Fine wine is not guilty." The old eunuch picked up the wine bottle on the ground and closed the lid."I do have something to do. I would like to borrow your place to do some private matters." Tang Yi nodded."Will someone die?" the old eunuch asked.Tang Yi shook his head and said: "No, but there might be some turmoil..." The old eunuch thought for a while and said: "That jug of wine is not enough. If there is turmoil in Tianxiang Tower, the sign of Tianxiang Tower will be smashed. You want to smash our sign with just a jug of wine? You can't." "Of course, unless you do.There is a reason to persuade our family to do something private." A cold look flashed in Tang Yi's eyes, and he said: "My sister is injured, covered with bruises, and the murderer is inside now." The old man's slightly closed eyes suddenly opened and he looked at Tang Yi: "Is it the little baby from yesterday?" Tang Yi nodded.The old man nodded slightly, then leaned on the recliner, his voice calm and indifferent: "Well, go ahead, hit him harder." Tang Yi stood up and bowed respectfully to the old man.Returning to Tianxiang Tower, looking at the endless stream of guests, Tang Yi couldn't help but feel a little sarcastic on his face.He knew the general situation of the Tang family. Tang Hao and his son had ruined the Tang family's business, and the government could not even afford a few hundred taels.As for the banquet at Tianxiang Tower, the minimum price is 10,000 taels.He really couldn't figure out where the Tang family still had money to entertain guests.Of course, this has nothing to do with him."Fourth brother, you are finally here." Before he reached the gate, Tang Hua had already greeted him with a smile."Today is a big day for our Tang family. If you don't come, Tang Hao and I are going to go back and carry you here." Tang Hua put his arms around Tang Yi's shoulders and smiled at Tang Jing: "Dad, look, I said that Xiao Yi can still clearly distinguish between right and wrong." Tang Yi glanced at Tang Hua lightly.This is a way to point him out!I took your poem to win the top spot, but you have to think about the overall situation. For the sake of the Tang family, you have to swallow your anger.Ha...what a beautiful thought!"What? Don't you have anything to say to your brother when you come?" Tang Jing felt a little relieved when he saw Tang Yilai.After all, today is the Tang family's banquet, but what's going on if the Tang family's legitimate son is not here?Just seeing Tang Yi's indifferent expression, he suddenly became dissatisfied: "Your brother has just won the first prize, and you don't even know how to say a few words of blessing?" Tang Yi smiled faintly and said, "I said congratulations, he might lose his head, are you sure?" Stealing poems in the imperial examination is a crime of deceiving the emperor.In this era, not only would Tang Hua lose his head, but it is hard to say that it would also affect the whole family."Presumptuous!" Tang Jing's face suddenly darkened, and he almost couldn't help but slap Tang Yi in the face.Your brother has just won the top prize and has an unlimited future. Do you dare to curse him?"Tang Yi, don't you know what's good and what's wrong. The person in front of you is the top scholar in the new subject and the editor of the Hanlin Academy. How dare you be so arrogant?" Tang Hao snorted coldly and said with a proud face: "Believe it or not, what my brother said now, beating you to death is like beating an ant to death?" Tang Hua glared at Tang Hao and said, "My brother, why are you talking about those who are not dead?" After saying that, Tang Hua put his arms around Tang Yi's shoulders and leaned against his ear.To outsiders, the two of them were talking in private, because the corners of Tang Hua's mouth had an elegant and charming smile.However.His words were extremely cold and full of provocation."My good brother, thank you so much." "If it weren't for that poem of yours, I might not have had the chance to be the No. 1 Scholar." "I know you're unwilling, but what can you do if you don't?" "You can only endure it now and want to resist... Haha, what do you think you're such a waste? Who do you think you are?I believe you!" At this point, Tang Hua's smile grew stronger and he said, "The person who helped you write that poem must be the so-called Xiao Shixian, right?How about you tell me who Xiao Shixian is?I promise to let you and Tang Yin live the rest of their lives in peace." "Little Shixian can't live!"Only by finding him and shutting him up completely will the fact that he stole poetry and won the first prize will be hidden forever.Tang Yi also laughed when he heard this and said: "Tang Hua, dance well, you can dance for a few days." "When the people who deal with you return to Kyoto, you will know what it means to be ruined." "As for the little poetry fairy..." Tang Yi raised his finger and pointed at himself and said: "Sorry, the little poetry fairy rumored outside is me." Tang Hua said in a low voice, no one heard.But Tang Yi did not lower his voice, and both Tang Jing and Tang Hao heard his words.Tang Hua and Tang Hao couldn't help but almost laughed to the sky. Are you a poetry immortal?Hahaha...are you a Shixian?If you were a poet?The Qinhuai River could be filled with the corpses of the entire Kyoto literati.Tang Jing's face was also livid, and he subconsciously wanted to cover Tang Yi's mouth. Fortunately, the guests who were supposed to come had already arrived, and they were the only two people in front of the door.Otherwise, if people hear Tang Yi's words, I don't know how big of a joke it will be!"You bastard, if you want glory, then use your skills to earn it like your brother. Bragging is nothing." Tang Jing stepped forward and angrily said: "I know you envy your brother, he won the first prize and you are mentally unbalanced, but please be honest with me today. If you dare to embarrass yourself, I can't spare you!" Tang Yi glanced at Tang Jing, and he added to the drama himself.Which eye of yours sees that I am mentally unbalanced?He was about to speak when a sharp voice came from outside the street."The prince has arrived!" Upon hearing these words, the noisy restaurant instantly became quiet.Tang Yi followed the sound and saw a luxurious carriage, protected by hundreds of soldiers and horses, slowly approaching the restaurant.Soon, the carriage stopped outside Tianxiang Tower.A young eunuch opened the car curtain and helped a young man get out of the car.The young man was tall and tall, dressed in brocade clothes, with long hair bound by a golden crown.
title_en: Chapter 48 Tang Yi is the only one standing in the whole place!
